pages.title: Bob the Minion Pulling the Sword From the Stone Coloring Page
pages.description: Bob the Minion pulls a sword from a stone in this printable coloring page, bracing his boots apart while gripping the hilt with both gloved hands. pages.title: Bob the Minion Carrying Poochy the Rat Through a London Sewer Coloring Page
pages.description: Bob the Minion carries Poochy the rat through a London sewer in this printable coloring page, cradling the smiling animal while stepping through rippling shallow water. The rat's long tail curls beside Bob's overalls, while curved brick arches, a dripping pipe, and a tall wall ladder stretch along the tunnel behind them.

pages.title: Bob the Minion Ringing the Palace Service Bell Coloring Page
pages.description: Bob the Minion rings a palace service bell in this printable coloring page, pressing the small top button with one gloved finger beside a paneled counter. Short ringing lines rise from the rounded bell, while Bob's wide grin, stitched overalls, tiled floor, and tall decorative wall panel complete the interior scene.

pages.description: Bob the Minion practices kung fu in this printable coloring page, holding a wide stance in a tied martial arts uniform beside a wooden training dummy. pages.description: Bob the Minion roasts a marshmallow beside Tim in this printable coloring page, sitting on a log with a long stick extended over a campfire. pages.description: Bob from Minions watches a screen in this printable coloring page, holding a teddy bear in a bonus room shared with two other goggled characters. pages.description: Bob from Minions thinks in a village in this printable coloring page, holding one hand beneath his mouth while standing atop a round stone platform. A large empty thought bubble rises above his half closed goggles, while steep roof houses, arched doors, leafy trees, a picket fence, and scattered pebbles frame the scene.

pages.description: Bob from Minions thinks inside a tunnel in this printable coloring page, resting a gloved hand against his chin beneath a small outlined question mark. pages.description: Bob from Minions smiles in a wheat field in this printable coloring page, standing with relaxed hands beside tall grain heads that reach above his shoulders. pages.description: Bob from Minions smiles in a game world in this printable coloring page, winking behind round goggles while standing on a broad outlined ground pattern. pages.description: Bob from Minions walks beside a waterfall in this printable coloring page, shown in profile with relaxed arms and one small boot stepping forward along the bank. pages.description: Bob from Minions walks on a lava platform in this printable coloring page, leading two other goggled figures across a broad rock with an uneven patterned surface.
